summary: Line-by-line verification of every dataset and HTML page in kanlerxz87-cyber/NFL2 against official NFL.com, NFL Official Playing Rules, official NFL club websites, and GitHub API state.

file_audits.detail: All 32 teams (W, L, T, PCT, PF, PA, Net, Home, Road, Div, Conf, Strk, Last5) match NFL.com 2026 regular-season division standings word-for-word.
All 32 teams reconcile identically with data/standings-2026.json and NFL.com 2026 division/league standings.
13 Week 11 games (dates, away/home, kickoff ET, TV, flex notes, Mexico City venue) + 6 Week 11 bye teams (ATL, CLE, GB, LAR, NE, SEA) = 32 teams accounted for.
13 Week 11 games + 6 bye teams match NFL.com Nov 9 schedule-change announcement and May 15 bye-week release.

The 6 game-status rows match the NFL.com Week 10 summary article, EXCEPT fullReport URL points to /REG9 (Week 9, Nov 5 JAX@BAL) instead of /REG10 (Week 10, Nov 12 WAS@NYG), and Ben Brown is listed OL in summary vs C on /REG10 and LG1/C2 on Patriots.com.
Wednesday Nov 11 roundup items verified against NFL.com news roundup; properly labelled as a Week 10 snapshot.
All 32 teams' pass_att_allowed, pass_yds_allowed, rush_att_allowed, rush_yds_allowed, rush_ypa_allowed, PF, and PA match NFL.com 2026 Defense Passing, Defense Rushing, and Standings pages.
All 10 passing rows and all 10 tackles rows match NFL.com exactly. Note IR-11: on NFL.com itself, Solo + Ast < Comb for 7 of top 10 tacklers due to special-teams tackles.

4 column-shift transcription errors caught: Bijan Robinson Rush TD recorded as 9 (official TD=5, 20+=9); Jaylen Warren Rush TD recorded as 7 (official TD=2, 20+=7; PIT team Rush TD=4); Trey McBride Rec Lng recorded as 41 (official Lng=27, Rec 1st%=41.1); Ja'Marr Chase Rec TD recorded as 8 (official TD=7, 20+=8).

Row 'NO at CHI' has 7 <td> cells instead of 8; baseline v0 calculator uses a single shared 'Games played' input g for both teams, whereas 8 of 13 Week 11 games pair an 8-game team against a 9-game team.
All 32 team names, conferences, divisions, and official nfl.com/teams/<slug> URLs verified.
GitHub Pages API reports build_type='legacy' serving '/' on main, while .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads 'docs/'. Both URLs resolve (/NFL2/ and /NFL2/docs/index.html) when cross-linked.

irregularities.finding: Full Week 10 injury report link pointed to the REG9 slug (which displays 'Injuries - WEEK 9', Nov 5 JAX at BAL). Official Week 10 full report is /injuries/league/2026/REG10 ('Injuries - WEEK 10', Nov 12 WAS at NYG).

irregularities.location: lines-lab.html (Week 11 template table, row 'NO at CHI')
irregularities.finding: HTML table row for 'NO at CHI' contains 7 <td> cells in an 8-column table (missing final Source/time cell).

Baseline v0 calculator assumes equal games played g for home and away teams. In official 2026 standings (as of Nov 12), 16 teams have played 8 games and 16 have played 9 games; 8 of 13 Week 11 games pair an 8-game team vs a 9-game team (e.g. IND 2-7 [9g] at HOU 3-5 [8g]). Fixed in originated-lines.html with separate g_away and g_home.
irregularities.status: Addressed in originated-lines.html + queued for S53-09

irregularities.finding: Bijan Robinson rushing TD recorded as 9; official NFL.com Player Rushing table lists RushYds=880, Att=169, TD=5, 20+=9, 40+=2, Lng=59. Column '20+' (9) was misread as 'TD' (5).
Jaylen Warren rushing TD recorded as 7; official NFL.com Player Rushing table lists RushYds=704, Att=119, TD=2, 20+=7, 40+=2, Lng=51 (and PIT entire team rushing TD total is 4).

Trey McBride longest reception (Lng) recorded as 41; official NFL.com Player Receiving table lists Rec=73, Yds=598, TD=5, 20+=4, 40+=0, Lng=27, Rec 1st=30, Rec 1st%=41.1. 'Rec 1st%' (41.1) was misread as 'Lng' (27).
Ja'Marr Chase receiving TD recorded as 8; official NFL.com Player Receiving table lists Rec=53, Yds=647, TD=7, 20+=8, 40+=2, Lng=47. Column '20+' (8) was misread as 'TD' (7).
NFL.com Player Rushing and Player Receiving category pages do not display Yds/Att or Yds/Rec columns directly; those two ratios were derived from Yds/Att and Yds/Rec without a 'derived' label.
Two parallel sessions created two complete dashboards (root / and docs/). GitHub Pages serves root '/' via legacy build_type, so docs/index.html was not linked from root index.html.

irregularities.location: NFL.com summary vs NFL.com REG10 vs Patriots.com depth chart (Ben Brown)
irregularities.finding: Official sources use different position granularity for Ben Brown (NE): 'OL' in NFL.com Week 10 summary, 'C' on NFL.com REG10 injury report, and 1st-string 'LG' + 2nd-string 'C' on Patriots.com depth chart.

irregularities.location: NFL.com Player Tackles table (upstream official source note)
irregularities.finding: On NFL.com's official Tackles page, CombTackles != Solo + Ast for 7 of the top 10 tacklers (e.g. Alex Singleton 107 Comb vs 56 Solo + 50 Ast = 106; Nakobe Dean 99 Comb vs 54 + 42 = 96) because NFL.com includes special-teams tackles in Comb.

Project prompt specifies session-<id>/<task> branches, whereas the execution environment fixes each session to a single branch arena/<id>-nfl2. Non-overlapping file scopes + rebase serialization enforce conflict-free parallel execution.
